clue.text: Change the law

definitions.meaning: loose change, small coins, as in a pocketful of pennies
slang for the police, as in officers on the beat

explanation.definitionFit: Copper coins make up small change, and coppers is British slang for police officers.

clue.text: The wood brought in once chopped smells nice

definitions.note: a verb phrase standing for a noun: the scented water that makes a person smell pleasant

indicators.note: one piece is brought inside the other, so the letters of the wood sit within the scrambled word
chopped up suggests the word once is cut and its letters reassembled

parts.note: a log is a piece of wood

explanation.surface: A woodcutter brings in freshly chopped timber that gives off a lovely scent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chopped' scrambles ONCE into CONE, and 'brought in' puts LOG inside it: CO-LOG-NE.
explanation.definitionFit: Eau de toilette is perfumed water worn to give a pleasant scent.

clue.text: What's going on at the rifle range that the doctor's in?

definitions.text: What's going on at the rifle range
definitions.meaning: a private is a soldier, so a soldier's shooting drill on the range
a physician working outside the National Health Service sees paying patients

explanation.definitionFit: A soldier rehearsing at the range is a private at practice; a doctor seeing fee-paying patients works outside public health care.

clue.text: Assumes they'll come back in it from Australia

definitions.note: standing for the large flightless birds native to that country

indicators.note: coming back means the letters run in the opposite direction
in signals letters lying inside the word Assumes

explanation.surface: Someone assumes certain travellers will return to the country from Australia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' points to SUME inside 'Assumes'; 'come back' turns it to EMUS.
explanation.definitionFit: These big flightless birds are native only to Australia.

clue.text: Looks around, saying the children will like them

indicators.note: around tells us one word wraps itself around another

parts.note: looks means sees
a saw is an old saying or proverb

explanation.surface: Someone glances about and remarks that the kids will enjoy something.
explanation.definitionFit: Playground teeter-totters are a favourite with youngsters.

clue.text: Lug, struggling, .into the seedy bar to spill the beans

indicators.note: into places the struggling word inside the bar

parts.note: a dive is a disreputable bar

indicators.note: struggling suggests the word Lug thrashing about, its letters disordered

explanation.surface: Someone lugs a heavy load into a sleazy pub and blurts out a secret.
explanation.walkthrough: 'struggling' turns LUG into ULG, and 'into' places it inside DIVE.
explanation.definitionFit: To reveal a secret is to let it out, the idiom spill the beans.

clue.text: Resolved to have the police go through the document

indicators.note: going through means the police sit right inside the document

parts.note: a deed is a legal document
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, British detective police

explanation.surface: Someone is determined to have officers examine a paper closely.
explanation.walkthrough: CID, the British police's detective branch, goes inside DEED.
explanation.definitionFit: Being determined on a course means having made up one's mind.

clue.text: Word for bottle that came to us by way of Latin

parts.note: via means by way of

explanation.surface: A word meaning a small bottle reached English through Latin.
explanation.definitionFit: A phial is a small glass container for liquids.

clue.text: The right bank

parts.note: bank as a ship's tilting, right as the nautical side, not a river's edge

explanation.definitionFit: A vessel leaning over towards its right-hand side is tilting that way.

clue.text: Guaranteed to contain a certain object

indicators.note: to contain means one word holds the other within it

parts.note: an end is an aim or object
certain means sure

explanation.surface: Something was promised to hold a particular item.
explanation.definitionFit: Making certain of something is guaranteeing it.

clue.text: Pupils on holiday?

parts.note: school forms with free time, punning on the social group that need not work

explanation.definitionFit: The idle rich are a social group with time free from work.

clue.text: Clothes for which there's a box in the car

definitions.meaning: informal word for clothing or kit

definitions.text: there's a box in the car
definitions.meaning: the gearbox is a box in a vehicle

explanation.definitionFit: Clothing is informally kit, and a car's transmission sits in its gearbox.

clue.text: Name that's the rage

definitions.meaning: a man's name, short for Patrick
a fit of temper, informal British usage

explanation.definitionFit: It is a nickname for Patrick and British slang for a tantrum.

clue.text: Awaken cooler

explanation.definitionFit: To rouse someone is to wake them, and both words are slang for jail.

clue.text: I am within call, up in the nursery

definitions.note: a plant found growing in a garden nursery

indicators.note: within places the single letter inside the turned word
in a down entry, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A child says it is within shouting distance, upstairs in the playroom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns CALL into LLAC and 'within' puts I inside it. The nursery is a plant nursery, not a child's room.
explanation.definitionFit: This flowering shrub is sold by garden centres.

clue.text: Long time getting to the point

parts.note: a year is a period of time
N is north, a compass point

explanation.surface: It takes a long time to get to the point.
explanation.definitionFit: To long for something is to crave it.

clue.text: Covers up when you look

parts.note: the skin folds that go up when the eyes open

explanation.definitionFit: These skin folds shut over the eyes and lift to let you see.

clue.text: Saucy nudes are not

definitions.meaning: having a sauce, like a salad

explanation.definitionFit: A salad with its sauce added is ready, and naked people are not clothed.

clue.text: Come up from the foaming waters beside one

indicators.note: beside means the two pieces stand next to each other

parts.note: surf is foaming breaking waves
an ace is a one in cards

explanation.surface: A swimmer rises from the frothy sea next to a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: To emerge from water is to rise to its top.

clue.text: A musical instrument and a bag, just

parts.note: a sack is a bag
but means only or just

explanation.surface: Someone lists a musical instrument and a bag, nothing more.
explanation.definitionFit: An early trombone was a Renaissance brass instrument.

clue.text: Not a good-looker!

parts.note: not an attractive person, but a gaze that wishes harm

explanation.definitionFit: A malevolent glance is believed to bring bad luck.

clue.text: Mean one has to dispose of rejects

parts.note: par is the average or mean
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: to dispose is to arrange, so the letters of has are set out anew

explanation.surface: An unkind person must throw out unwanted items.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dispose' here means arrange, rearranging HAS as AHS after PAR and I.
explanation.definitionFit: Outcasts are people society has rejected.

clue.text: Head first

definitions.meaning: a leader, as of a government

explanation.definitionFit: A prime minister heads a government, and the word also means foremost.

clue.text: Because the note is genuine

parts.note: since means because
re is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A banknote is accepted because it is not a forgery.
explanation.definitionFit: Heartfelt and honest feelings are real.

clue.text: Prepare to shoot the bird

definitions.meaning: to raise a gun's hammer ready for firing

explanation.definitionFit: Raising a gun's hammer readies it to fire, and a rooster is a male chicken.

clue.text: She's dangerous and that's a warning!

definitions.meaning: a femme fatale, like the singing sea-nymphs of myth

explanation.definitionFit: A seductive dangerous woman is named after the mythical sea-nymphs, and the word also means an alarm.

clue.text: Get a round at the bar-port

parts.note: O is round in shape
to ban is to bar

explanation.surface: Someone buys a round of drinks at the bar, perhaps of port.
explanation.walkthrough: OBAN is a harbour town in western Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: This Scottish west-coast town is a ferry harbour.

clue.text: It means you've decided to keep your word

definitions.text: It means you've decided to keep your word

parts.words: It means you've decided to keep your word
parts.note: the proofreading mark telling a printer to leave a word unchanged

explanation.definitionFit: This Latin mark instructs that a deleted word should remain after all.

clue.text: So throw the line out to us

indicators.note: out means the line is left out of the word throw

parts.note: a row is a line

explanation.surface: An angler casts a fishing line towards us.
explanation.walkthrough: Take ROW from THROW to leave TH, then add US.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean in this way or therefore.

clue.text: Be angry with the barber whose razor was blunt?

definitions.text: Be angry with the barber whose razor was blunt?

parts.words: Be angry with the barber whose razor was blunt?
parts.note: a shaver's stubble left standing in fury, the idiom for being furious

explanation.definitionFit: To show great anger is the idiom; stubble that a dull blade fails to cut stays standing.

clue.text: At present is outside the operations room

indicators.note: is outside means one word goes round the other

parts.note: there means present, as when answering a register

explanation.surface: Someone currently waits beyond the surgery doors.
explanation.definitionFit: Surgery takes place in a hospital's operating room.

clue.text: The balance of the negotiated rise that's owing

indicators.note: negotiated suggests the word rise is worked over and its letters reshuffled

parts.note: due means owing

explanation.surface: The remaining sum of an agreed pay rise is still outstanding.
explanation.definitionFit: What remains after the rest is used is the remainder.
